name: Fey Healing
body:
School transmutation (healing); Level bloodrager 3, druid 3, magus 3, ranger 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, witch 3
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 10)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like lesser fey healing except it grants fast healing 2 and you detect as a chaotically-aligned cleric with a level equal to the caster level of the spell.
